column3: description  (Build Standard v1.2.0; synced via gh label create --force)
Code does something different from its spec or intent (a defect in program logic)
Wrong number, claim, doc, config, version, build or command
Works and is not wrong, but is unclear, inconsistent, fragile or hard to maintain
External obstacle (network, account, toolchain) blocks progress
Risk that has not caused harm yet (security, cost, legal, reliability)
Trade-off between valid options; the owner decides
Two requirements or rules contradict each other
Something required or expected is missing; nothing present is wrong
Missing check or safeguard, so a defect could pass unnoticed
A user, platform, failure mode or assumption nobody has examined yet
Needs classification
Question about usage or design
Replication report (successful or not)
Security-related
Documentation
AI model, prompt, eval or budget
Lean 4 formalization, multi-kernel audit, or statement fidelity
Primary-source DOI/arXiv resolution, retraction audit, or bibliography verification
2024-2026 mathematical breakthrough or status transition
